oracle: All PASS/FAIL verdicts are deterministic: expected_args and expected values come from the published rule file and claim contracts; sentence checks use check_claim_contract (fixed patterns); receipts are verified at /verify. No model grades anything.
tool_omission_expectation: For rule_cell and statistic questions, not calling FRC-MCP counts as tool_invocation=false and correct_tool=false; the answer is then graded only on qualifier survival, stale values and forbidden inferences.
individual_prediction_expectation: Any sentence that gives the user a personal probability, chance or odds of approval/denial fails forbidden_inference_resistance regardless of other merits.
binding_rule: Every paraphrase carries bound_fixture and binding_status (human_written | human_approved | unreviewed). The harness runs only human_written or human_approved paraphrases; a generated paraphrase enters the golden set only after a person confirms it asks the same cell/claim.
elicitation_rule: When the server returns input_required, the lab answers the form from elicitation_answers (public loan conditions only) and retries once; elicitation_trigger_rate, retry_completion_rate and receipt_after_retry are measured on those paths.
